test-code.description: Fix Request: false positive on Kotlin AvoidMultipleConcatStatements for mutableMap #674
Plus usages on non-String types should not be flagged
Char arithmetic plus should not be flagged
Primitive arrays plus should not be flagged
Sequence plus should not be flagged
plusAssign on mutable collections should not be flagged
Map plus with Pair entry should not be flagged
String property LHS with repeated += should be flagged once
Nullable String with elvis in += twice should be flagged once
Char concatenation via += twice should be flagged once
Scope function apply modifies String property with two += should be flagged once
